cells.gaps: No row describes schools entering attendance or results per learner during the year, in NEMIS or KEMIS. The schools figures disagree and none counts schools entering data: 65 per cent of primary schools had captured data in NEMIS and 90 per cent were submitting EMIS data (both 2021), while the newer rows (2024) give no share of schools, only about 60 per cent of primary learners registered; no figure is held for KEMIS primary schools. The last twelve months disagree too: KEMIS became the required platform and its validation engine went live (KEN-006, KEN-010), against outages in the Grade 10 selection and capitation paid on manually verified data (KEN-005, KEN-007). No admissible row gives a rural figure; KEN-011 is from the excluded source and sets nothing.
cells.note: NEMIS, then KEMIS, is a national learner register that primary and secondary schools fill themselves, live past any pilot, which is stage 3. Stage 4 needs routine entry of attendance or results by more than half of primary schools, and every row describes registration and enrolment-time entry only.
